# Asha Garment Factory

> Asha Garment Factory (AGF) is an ethical OEM and private label garment manufacturer in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded in 2011, it produces women's, men's and kids wear for brands in the USA, UK, Switzerland, Qatar, UAE and India, and its profits support children's homes and single mothers in India.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2011
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Services: OEM and private label clothing manufacturing; sampling; fabric sourcing; cutting and stitching; embroidery, screen printing and heat-transfer embellishment; custom labels, hangtags and packaging; three-stage quality control; export logistics and documentation
- Product categories: women's wear (dresses, tops, blouses); men's wear (shirts, t-shirts, polos, trousers); kids wear (tops, bottoms, sets, school uniforms); lifestyle and activewear
- Minimum order quantity: from 500 pieces per style for bulk production; smaller sample orders accepted
- Sample development: 2–4 weeks from tech pack or reference sample
- Bulk production lead time: 6–10 weeks after sample approval
- Export markets: USA, UK, Switzerland and Europe, Qatar, UAE and the Middle East
- Ethics: fair wages, fixed working hours, safe working conditions, fabric-waste reduction; profits fund education for underprivileged children and skills training for single mothers
- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours
